summary: This is a routine earnings release and dividend declaration by Federal Home Loan Bank of Atlanta. The filing reports unaudited Q1 2026 results (net interest income $205M, net income $142M) and a board-declared dividend at an annualized rate of 6.40%. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is involved. It is a standard 8-K filing under Items 2.02 and 8.01 for operating results and a dividend announcement, with no special-situation event.
